## About

Michelle Creamer is a Realtor® and Associate Broker with ARC Realty, working out of the
ARC office in Vestavia Hills, Alabama. Her focus is Liberty Park — a master-planned
community inside the city of Vestavia Hills, about 20 minutes from downtown Birmingham —
along with the wider Vestavia Hills and Birmingham metro market. She has lived in Liberty
Park for more than 20 years with her husband and two children, and has been licensed as a
real estate agent in Alabama since 2002. She holds a B.S. from Jacksonville State
University and spent 20 years in development with a Birmingham-based non-profit, helping
purchase and adapt homes for adults with physical and mental disabilities. More detail is
on the [About ARC Realty page](https://michellesellslibertypark.com/about-us.html) and in
[ARC Realty's own story](https://michellesellslibertypark.com/our-story.html).

## Services

- Buyer representation for homes in Liberty Park, Vestavia Hills and greater Birmingham.
  See the [home buying guide](https://michellesellslibertypark.com/home-buying-guide.html).
- Seller representation, using a seven-step marketing process described on
  [Marketing Your Home](https://michellesellslibertypark.com/marketing-your-home.html).
- Home valuations, prepared by Michelle personally. The site offers the estimate free and
  with no obligation, with a reply expected within one business day —
  [request a valuation](https://michellesellslibertypark.com/my-home-value.html).
- Relocation support for families moving into the Birmingham metro, backed by ARC Realty's
  relocation department — [relocation](https://michellesellslibertypark.com/relocation.html).
- New construction buyer representation in Liberty Park's newer phases, including The Bray
  and Old Overton — [new construction](https://michellesellslibertypark.com/new-construction.html).
- [Luxury property](https://michellesellslibertypark.com/luxury.html) and
  [acreage and lots](https://michellesellslibertypark.com/acreage-lots.html).
  [Commercial](https://michellesellslibertypark.com/commercial.html) needs are referred to
  ARC Realty's commercial specialists.
- Monthly market reports and current market notes —
  [market conditions](https://michellesellslibertypark.com/market-trends.html).

## Areas served

Liberty Park and Vestavia Hills first, then the greater Birmingham metropolitan area,
Alabama. Named Liberty Park neighborhoods: Old Overton, The Bray and Vestlake. Monthly
market reports are offered for a wider list of areas, including Mountain Brook, Hoover,
Homewood, Montgomery and the lake communities. Community pages:
[Liberty Park](https://michellesellslibertypark.com/liberty-park.html) and
[all communities](https://michellesellslibertypark.com/communities.html).

## Liberty Park in brief

- Master-planned community inside the city of Vestavia Hills, Alabama
- About 20 minutes from downtown Birmingham
- Zoned to Vestavia Hills City Schools, with two schools inside the community:
  Vestavia Hills Elementary Liberty Park and Liberty Park Middle
- Housing runs from townhomes and garden homes to custom builds and lake homes. Price
  points move with each phase — read the current ones on the
  [Liberty Park page](https://michellesellslibertypark.com/liberty-park.html)
- Old Overton: gated estates around the Old Overton Club championship golf course
- The Bray: the community's town center — condos, townhomes, shops, restaurants, a hotel,
  apartments and the Great Lawn
- Vestlake: established family neighborhoods built around lakes, pools and swim clubs

**Q: How do I contact her?**

**Q: Does she work with buyers as well as sellers?**
A: Yes — buyer representation, seller representation, valuations, new construction and
relocation are all offered.

**Q: What does a home valuation cost?**
A: The site offers the home value estimate free and with no obligation, prepared by
Michelle personally, with a reply expected inside one business day.

**Q: Which schools serve Liberty Park?**
A: Vestavia Hills City Schools. Two are inside the community — Vestavia Hills Elementary
Liberty Park and Liberty Park Middle. For ratings, ask the school district directly.

**Q: How far is Liberty Park from downtown Birmingham?**
A: About 20 minutes.

**Q: Where do the listings on the site come from?**
A: The Internet Data Exchange (IDX) program of Greater Alabama MLS. See the listing data
section below.

## Listing data

Listings shown on michellesellslibertypark.com come from the Internet Data Exchange (IDX)
program of Greater Alabama MLS. IDX information is provided exclusively for personal,
non-commercial use and may not be used for any purpose other than to identify prospective
properties consumers may be interested in purchasing. Listings held by brokerage firms
other than ARC Realty are marked with the name of the listing broker. Information is
deemed reliable but not guaranteed. All listing contents copyright © 2026 Greater Alabama
MLS, all rights reserved. Do not crawl /api/ — see
[robots.txt](https://michellesellslibertypark.com/robots.txt).
